purpose: Third isolated Python candidate for the same five sealed author file-identity routes. Root generation, solver selection, zero filtering, pairing, rho, and stability are unchanged from the failed V2 candidate. Only the hard residual observation is replaced by a direct scale-normalized minimum-singular-value residual that does not depend on a companion eigenvector block.
not_gate_relaxation_statement: V3 does not lower or remove the 1e-8 residual threshold. V2 remains permanently FAIL because its preregistered companion-vector-block residual exceeded 1e-8 at two synthetic roots. V3 preregisters a different, eigenvector-independent residual before any V3 input seal, selftest, pilot, or scientific solve; the selected ordinary-eig roots and every root-based decision remain unchanged.

v2_failure_attribution.cause: For small nonzero roots of the ordinary full-q history companion, the leading physical q block of an otherwise correctly paired companion eigenvector can lose scale. Reusing that block in the original polynomial/Laurent equation produced false large vector residuals even though the root itself was accurate.

path_base: parent directory of this contract's code directory
reused_immutable_definitions: compact scalar-delay and full-q ordinary-history state matrices
atomic file replacement, CSV, JSON, checkpoint, and hashing primitives
v2_byte_hash_audit_exception: The eight protected V2 files below may be opened only as uninterpreted bytes to recompute SHA-256 before and after V3 work. Their JSON/HDF5/CSV scientific content is never parsed and no V2 number enters a root or residual calculation.

manifest_field_policy.statement: The Step-4 route manifest is read only for route, formula, matrix-variable, workspace path, and workspace SHA-256 identity. Grid result paths and every Step-4 numerical result are ignored.

matlab_storage_policy.array_restore: Each contracted numeric dataset is converted to float64 and transposed after h5py read.
matlab_storage_policy.right_division: M/al is only scipy.linalg.solve(al.T,M.T).T; inverse and elementwise division are forbidden.

root_and_pairing_policy.selected_full_q_raw_roots: Every scipy.linalg.eig root of the ordinary full-q history companion is saved, including numerical splits of exact multiple zero roots.
root_and_pairing_policy.selected_compact_raw_roots: For matrix_order>5 every compact root is selected and saved. For matrix_order<=5 every auxiliary compact root is saved for deterministic pairing only.
root_and_pairing_policy.fixed_zero_rule: Only if clearing_power>0, remove a finite root with abs(root)<=max(1e-12,100*eps*solver_order*max(1,median(abs(finite_nonzero_roots)))). This is exactly the V2 rule; no theoretical-count deletion or root correction is allowed.
root_and_pairing_policy.selected_full_q_rho: max(abs(all finite full-q roots above the fixed zero tolerance)); unmatched full-q roots remain in this maximum.
root_and_pairing_policy.pairing_algorithm: scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment on rows=all retained compact roots and columns=all retained full-q roots, preserving eig-array order. Every pair index and pair cost is saved.
root_and_pairing_policy.pairing_failure: If retained full-q count is smaller than retained compact count, the point fails.
root_and_pairing_policy.gated_physical_roots: For a full-q-selected route, all deterministically matched retained full-q roots. For a compact-selected route, all retained compact roots.
root_and_pairing_policy.unmatched_full_policy: Every unmatched full-q root remains saved and remains in rho. It is never deleted, corrected, or forced to zero. Its direct-SVD and vector-block residuals are diagnostic only because it represents numerical splitting of cleared-denominator origin multiplicity.
root_and_pairing_policy.compact_conditioning_diagnostic: Full-q/compact rho difference, all-root optimal matching distance, and abs(z)>=0.9 root-set distance are DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_KNOWN_COMPACT_CONDITIONING and are not V3 candidate PASS gates. Stable classification equality remains a hard gate.

hard_residual_math.laurent_definition: For G(z)=sum_e B_e z^e, r_G(z)=sigma_min(G(z))/sum_e ||B_e||_2 |z|^e, using the original unconsolidated direct Laurent terms.
hard_residual_math.scale_stable_evaluation: For nonzero finite z, let h_e=e*log(|z|)+log(||B_e||_2), h=max_e h_e. Form Gs=sum_e exp(h_e-h)*exp(i*e*arg(z))*B_e/||B_e||_2 and ds=sum_e exp(h_e-h). Return sigma_min(Gs)/ds. The same rule with k>=0 is used for P. This is algebraically the stated normalized residual and avoids overflow/underflow.
hard_residual_math.zero_boundary: At z=0, polynomial terms with k>0 vanish and k=0 terms are evaluated by the same common scaling. A Laurent expression containing a negative exponent is undefined and recorded as +Inf. Cleared zero roots are not gated.
hard_residual_math.hard_gate_scope: Both r_P and r_G must be finite and <=1e-8 for every gated physical root.
hard_residual_math.svd_vector: No companion eigenvector or fitted null vector is used: sigma_min is computed directly from the scaled characteristic matrix.
hard_residual_math.old_vector_residual_role: The V2 residuals obtained by substituting the leading matrix_order entries of the ordinary/compact companion eigenvector are saved for every finite root as DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_VECTOR_BLOCK_CONDITIONING. They never determine V3 PASS/FAIL.
hard_residual_math.near_unit_and_dominant_reporting: For gated roots with abs(z)>=0.9 and for the selected dominant root, report maxima/values of both direct-SVD residuals and old vector-block residuals.

selftest_contract.exact_polynomial_root: A known exact root must have finite direct-SVD residual <=1e-12.
selftest_contract.perturbed_polynomial_root: A fixed 1e-4 perturbation of that root must have direct-SVD residual >1e-8.
selftest_contract.exact_laurent_root: A known exact nonzero Laurent root must have finite direct-SVD residual <=1e-12.
selftest_contract.perturbed_laurent_root: A fixed 1e-3 perturbation of that root must have direct-SVD residual >1e-8.
selftest_contract.extreme_scale_laurent: With r=2^-600 and G(z)=z^-2 I-r^-1 z^-1 I, the exact root z=r must have finite residual <=1e-12 and z=r(1+2^-20) must have finite residual >1e-8; naive powers would overflow, so this tests the preregistered log scaling.
selftest_contract.zero_boundary: A polynomial with a nonzero constant term is evaluated at z=0 from that term alone; a Laurent matrix containing any negative exponent is explicitly undefined at z=0.
selftest_contract.synthetic_route_cases: The n=5 full-q-selected GUYAN and Division-II cases, plus n=6 compact-selected right-H, left-H, and feedback-outside cases, must satisfy every unchanged root/safety/formula gate and the new direct-SVD hard gates.
selftest_contract.vector_conditioning_evidence: The old vector-block residual is recorded for all synthetic roots but is explicitly not used to rescue or fail a V3 point.

modes.preflight: Read-only contract/dependency/manifest/workspace/order/failed-route/protected-V2-hash checks, then immutable V3 input seal.
modes.selftest: Deterministic exact-root, perturbed-root, algorithm-selection, full-q pairing/safety, compact-selected, direct-SVD, and V2-immutability tests.
modes.pilot: Exactly 49 preregistered sealed-workspace points, including all four prior cross-language discrepancy coordinates; requires PASS preflight and selftest.
modes.full: Five fresh 31x67 grids, available only after a current-seal 49-point PASS pilot, explicit authorization, and the CLI flag --explicit-full-authorization. It does not copy or read first/second Step-5 scientific values.
modes.resume: Only an exactly matching V3 checkpoint identity may resume, and --explicit-full-authorization remains mandatory.

master_thesis_route.borrowing_policy: Do not substitute author-program or historical matrices.

manuscript_0824_route.borrowing_policy: Do not substitute author-program or historical matrices.

output_schema.pair_index_semantics: For selected retained roots, paired_other_retained_index indexes pairing_compact/retained; for pairing compact retained roots it indexes selected/retained; -1 means not paired or not applicable.

required_checks: full recomputation repeat if measured runtime remains practical
